evidenceIndex.summary:
## Summary
Added intelligent command suggestion system to Typer that detects typos and suggests corrections.

Users get confusing errors when they mistype commands:
"No such command: 'gret'"

## Solution

"No such command: 'gret'. Did you mean 'greet'?"

- CommandSuggester class with comprehensive typo detection
- Detects missing/extra characters, missing vowels/consonants
- Substring matching and case-insensitive matching
- Confidence-based suggestion ranking
- SmartTyperApp integration
- 28 comprehensive test cases

goals.summary: Add an intelligent command suggestion mechanism to Typer to detect typos and suggest alternative commands for CLI users.

facets.summary: Users encounter confusing error messages when entering mistyped commands without helpful suggestions.
Identifies similar commands via difflib SequenceMatcher to append suggestions like Did you mean to the unrecognized command error.

Adds a CommandSuggester class supporting typo checks, character/vowel variations, substring and case-insensitive matching, confidence scoring, SmartTyperApp integration, and zero external dependencies.
Author reports 28 passing unit test cases covering various scenarios and real-world CLI patterns without affecting existing tests.

candidates.whyInspect: Defines the core CommandSuggester class, command registration, and typo type detection mechanism introduced by this PR.
candidates.reviewQuestion: How are commands and aliases stored and configured for typo matching, and does detect_typo_type cover all expected heuristic variants?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain whether helper methods referenced later like format_suggestion_message are fully defined in this module.

candidates.whyInspect: Implements candidate suggestion retrieval using SequenceMatcher and difflib.get_close_matches ranking.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Does get_suggestions correctly filter, score, and prioritize command suggestions based on threshold and substring checks?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain whether get_suggestion singular method used in test cases is implemented or missing.

candidates.whyInspect: Defines SmartTyperApp and its command registration and resolution logic interacting with CommandSuggester.
candidates.reviewQuestion: How does SmartTyperApp integrate with or differ from standard Typer applications, and how does it propagate suggestion errors?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain whether SmartTyperApp integrates with Typer or Click runtime pipelines or functions as a standalone prototype.

candidates.whyInspect: Shows existing TyperGroup command resolution and its existing get_close_matches suggestion handling in core Typer.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Does core TyperGroup command resolution use or integrate with the new CommandSuggester or remain separate?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain whether core Typer was intended to be updated to invoke CommandSuggester.

candidates.whyInspect: Implements get_suggestions_with_confidence for returning matched commands alongside similarity ratios.
candidates.reviewQuestion: How are confidence ratios computed and ranked when returning suggestions with confidence scores?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain whether fallback to get_close_matches preserves threshold score consistency.

candidates.whyInspect: Contains unit tests verifying command registration, missing character typos, extra character typos, and substring matching.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Do the typo matching tests validate CommandSuggester across all claimed variation cases, and do called methods exist?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain whether get_suggestion is defined on CommandSuggester as asserted by tests.

candidates.whyInspect: Verifies SmartTyperApp registration and expected error messages when an unknown command is supplied.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Does SmartTyperApp raise the expected ValueError formatted with suggestion text when an unrecognized command is executed?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain how CLI invocation and execution are tested beyond direct get_command calls.

candidates.whyInspect: Tests real-world CLI command patterns such as git, docker, and npm typo examples against CommandSuggester.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Are real-world CLI typo scenarios accurately resolved to expected targets under default threshold settings?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain whether edge cases with similar short commands produce false positives.

candidates.whyInspect: Defines TyperGroup initialization and the suggest_commands parameter flag.
candidates.reviewQuestion: Does TyperGroup configuration tie into the newly introduced suggestions module?
candidates.uncertainty: Uncertain whether suggest_commands is related to the new suggester or an existing Typer feature.

uncertainty: Uncertain whether typer/__init__.py exports CommandSuggester and SmartTyperApp for public use.
